author: Axiom III
title: XL Scheduler Adapter Demo — decisions for common offsets
abstract: Demonstrates consuming xl_policy_zephyr_v.json and producing allow/wait/recommend decisions for offsets {0,2,4,6,8,10,12}.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.scheduler_xl_adapter import load_policy, decide

pol = load_policy()
results = {off: decide(pol, requested_offset=off) for off in [0,2,4,6,8,10,12]}
print(json.dumps({"policy_summary": pol.get("summary", None), "decisions": results}, indent=2))
